Registering to the Portal

When you first access the portal you want to register, you'll be greeted with their login page. To register for an account for this portal you click the "Register" button which will bring up a dialog that looks something like this:

The "Display Name" here is the username you wish to sign in with, the "Email" address should be filled in with your company email address. The "Password" and the "Confirm Password" fields need to be filled in with the password you wish to use when signing into the portal. You must read and agree to the terms and conditions and the data protection policy to create an account with our portals. To view these documents, click the links and you will be redirected to the page where you can read them.
